accepted_claims: MC-015 provides a programme-owned exact certificate checker that is structurally independent from candidate geometry and the MC-010/MC-011/MC-012/MC-013/MC-014 oracle implementations.

The checker rejects candidate-owned truth/checking authority, false oracle independence, shared decisive geometry, non-success terminal promotion, binary-float authority and invalid exact material sandwiches.

Material probes, exact component count, durable body identity and lineage are non-compensating certificate obligations, so aggregate volume agreement cannot hide a lost thin web, filled channel, added bridge, deleted body or lost lineage.

An exact 1/1000000 positive material witness remains positive, exact tangent/boundary state remains distinct, and valid exact-empty material may pass while exhausted durable body identity is retained.
The adversarial verifier pins the reviewed dependency/oracle/historical-import sources and reruns the MC-009 binding-verifier corruption suite.
F01-F16 remain mandatory BUILT prospective fixtures; this task does not convert fixture construction into candidate PASS, native geometry evidence or a capability-gate result.
open_claims: The MC-015 checker validates supplied certificate statements and discriminating witnesses; it does not prove that the witness set is complete over the full machining domain.
MC-007 transcendental/tangential blockers and all propagated proof obligations remain open under their recorded downstream owners.
No native geometry candidate has been executed or qualified by MC-015.
Native material/topology/reconstruction correctness and independent STEP engineering qualification remain unestablished.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: reject binary floating authority and malformed exact material bounds
reject timeout/resource exhaustion as certificate success
reject candidate-owned checker, expected truth or inclusion-proof authority
reject false oracle independence and shared decisive geometry
reject inconsistent/over-broad material sandwiches and unproved inclusion relations
reject lost positive thin material, filled void/channel and tangent collapse
reject wrong component count, lost durable body identity and lost lineage
reject positive residual material rounded to empty and duplicate witness identities

review.disposition: completed independent certificate/checker and oracle-adversarial research only; no native geometry or capability promotion
review.downstream_release: artifact dependents may consume the MC-015 checker and adversarial contract while preserving its bounded witness scope and every recorded open proof/native/output obligation

downstream_invalidations: changing the MC-009 binding schema/verifier requires a reviewed MC-015 compatibility revision
changing any pinned oracle or F01-F16 fixture meaning requires re-review of affected certificate assumptions and controls
changing the MC-055 historical import requires explicit provenance review without rewriting historical evidence
a later checker/oracle defect supersedes affected certificates but may not remove failures or shrink the mandatory corpus
